The mechanism is verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb `record_for_host` does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` after setting `host = uri.host`, but it never explicitly normalizes the argument (e.g., `host.downcase`). If `uri.host` can contain uppercase (or if future callers pass a non-normalized host string), this comparison would be case-sensitive on the RHS despite lowercasing the column. The diff doesn’t prove this will happen (depends on `URI(...).host` behavior / caller inputs), but it’s a concrete edge-case risk in the new host-allowlist logic.
